name: University of Maryland
character: The 1,250-acre campus features the large McKeldin Mall, Georgian-style halls, 7,500 documented trees, nearly 400 acres of urban forest, and the Paint Branch stream.

landmarks.name: McKeldin Mall
landmarks.quote: The center of the university's 1,250 acres (5.1 km2) is McKeldin Mall, which is the largest academic mall in the United States.
landmarks.look: Vast open grassy academic mall bordered by buildings on all sides.

landmarks.name: McKeldin Library
landmarks.quote: The Mall is bordered on the west and east by McKeldin Library and the Thomas V. Miller, Jr. Administration Building, respectively.
landmarks.look: Plain library building bordering the west end of McKeldin Mall.

landmarks.name: The "M"
landmarks.quote: at the campus hallmark, The "M", which is a mound with a large "M" formed by flowers in its center.
landmarks.look: Grassy mound with a large letter M formed by flowers in its center.

landmarks.name: Morrill Quad
landmarks.quote: the original center of campus, Morrill Hall and the Morrill Quad.
landmarks.look: Historic campus quadrangle at the original center of campus.

landmarks.name: Morrill Hall
landmarks.quote: the original center of campus, Morrill Hall and the Morrill Quad.
landmarks.look: Plain historic academic hall on Morrill Quad.

landmarks.name: North Gate
landmarks.quote: referred to as North Gate and features the Gatehouse, an ornate gateway honoring the university's founders.
landmarks.look: Ornate gateway and gatehouse at the main campus entrance.

landmarks.name: Rossborough Inn
landmarks.quote: The Rossborough Inn, which was built during the years 1798 to 1812, is the oldest building on campus
landmarks.look: Historic late-18th to early-19th-century building, plain in style.

landmarks.name: University of Maryland Arboretum & Botanical Garden
landmarks.name_en: University of Maryland Arboretum & Botanical Garden
landmarks.quote: designate the campus the University of Maryland Arboretum & Botanical Garden in 2008.
landmarks.look: Expansive campus grounds filled with thousands of trees and garden plantings.
